seed_form: Unique carbon-containing component; strip only atomic counterions, preserve charges/stereo/isotopes; record source and used forms. Reject ambiguous multiple organic components.
library: Frozen v0.2.0 canonical library; common reference pool uses valid single-component carbon-containing subset, recompute both descriptors before filtering.
output_form: Require raw generated molecule to have one connected carbon-containing component; never strip generated counterions to rescue a failed output.

g_models.action: Recompute consistent canonical RDKit labels, rebuild lower-property triplets, train separate LogP and TPSA adaptations from the same frozen initializer before LLM generation.
g_models.triplets: Morgan cosine nearest10 non-self neighbors within each fixed split; positive minimum property, negative maximum; skip degenerate ties; no mixed old labels.

training.loss: Retain existing InfoNCE definition; record dot-product training versus normalized-cosine inference explicitly.
training.checkpoint_selection: Lowest held-out validation loss only, no downstream generated scores.

g_models.split: Retain existing train/val/test canonical assignments; no cross-split triplet neighbors; test not used to choose epochs; remove exact normalized task seeds from fine-tuning sets if present.

reference_pool: Same basic chemical and exact property-band filter for M/G/R for each task; exclude current normalized seed; no QED/SA or similarity prefilter.

retrieval.M: Original radius2/2048bit binary Morgan cosine top3, canonical tie-break
retrieval.G: Attribute-specific normalized embedding cosine top3, canonical tie-break
retrieval.R: Uniform sample3 without replacement within the same pool, seed fixed by property/task/repeat; one set per run, fixed across both design rounds

shared_context: Share external target/literature/pocket input sources and prompt templates only. Each slot independently makes all five calls; never reuse generated assistant replies across slots, methods, repeats or properties.

model.version_control: Save model catalog/documentation/time/request/response model metadata; interleave both properties and all methods; aliases do not pin immutable weights.
model.retry_policy: Follow Study-B bounded whole-trajectory retries for transport/empty/truncated technical failures only. Retain all attempts; use the first technically completed attempt, no quality-based attempt choice.

schedule: Seed42 randomized property/task/repeat blocks, randomized method order within each block; 250 blocks x4 methods.
final_selection: Eligible union across two rounds; last canonical occurrence; highest QED, then lowest SA_raw, then canonical ascending; empty eligible set => no output.

pilot.design: First2 frozen tasks x2 properties x4 groups at repeat1; technical criteria only; include in1000 if identical scientific protocol.
pilot.scientific_changes: Retain development pilot separately and restart a fully specified protocol version; no performance-based target/seed/model tuning.

primary_statistics.unit: 25 paired target means per property, five planned runs per target; missing deliveries remain zero

secondary_statistics.multiplicity: Separate predeclared secondary family, Holm across8
secondary_statistics.distributions_and_structure: Descriptive paired intervals and full curves, no selective unadjusted significance claims

docking.role: Secondary computational comparison after final generation, following the currently corrected Study-B receptor protocol
docking.inclusion: Current published primary_nonmetal_calibrated subset, fixed before new generation; do not use obsolete original20-target inclusion as if it were the current11-target set.
docking.missing_output_or_prep_or_docking_failur: Keep original position and failure reason; no favorable-subset replacement or zero-as-affinity imputation.

protocol.ligand: Use the same frozen standardized single-component forms and current RDKit/MMFF/Meeko preparation for seeds and all groups.

docking.deterministic_cache: If used, key on target, canonical ligand, receptor/grid hash and full preparation/scoring protocol; repeated records are retained.
docking.direct_baselines: If comparing their Vina, score all relevant three baseline outputs on the same11 targets, at most66 additional records.
docking.interpretation: Conditional computational Vina and delta from matched seed, with delivery and docking-completion denominators reported; no claim of measured affinity.

historical_B: Preserve old ring-generation records. Match its five-call generation skeleton and current corrected docking protocol; new property encoders, seed normalization, available service and R arm are documented changes, not assertions of identical historical conditions.
deliverables: All1000 planned positions and all6000 nominal proposal positions
Paired target summaries and declared tests
supersedes: Earlier plan that shared frozen LLM background replies and deferred docking

five_turns.role: Molecular design setup and SMILES/task rules; adapt RC-specific statement to current descriptor.
Literature information extraction from the same archived target abstracts.
Analyze archived target/pocket information, acknowledge unavailable binding data without inventing contacts.
Conditioned design using seed plus none or three fixed references; propose three tagged SMILES.
External RDKit/SA feedback on the three turn4 positions; propose three optimized tagged SMILES.

pilot_review: Check task interpretation, valid actual structures, descriptor windows, factual program feedback, selection and resume. No requirement that GIN wins. Systematic problems must be resolved with explicit protocol-version records.

balance.insufficient: Stop submitting, drain in-flight replies to durable storage, preserve per-call/slot state, resume same slot and cached successful turns after top-up.

structural_sensitivity.interpretation: Descriptive saved-candidate sensitivity; not additional paid generation or a hard constraint in the primary experiment.
structural_sensitivity.mcs: Maximum atoms, elements/bond order, ring-to-chain allowed, no chirality/charge match; timeouts2/10/30s with completion flags and lower/upper bounds.
